verses.text: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,

xrefs.text: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
So then, those who suffer according to God’s will should entrust their souls to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.
This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:

But the LORD is with me like a fearsome warrior. Therefore, my persecutors will stumble and will not prevail. Since they have not succeeded, they will be utterly put to shame, with an everlasting disgrace that will never be forgotten.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

verses.text: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

xrefs.text: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, so that through me the message would be fully proclaimed, and all the Gentiles would hear it. So I was delivered from the mouth of the lion.
I composed myself until the morning. Like a lion He breaks all my bones; from day until night You make an end of me.
Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
Concerning Gad he said: “Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion and tears off an arm or a head.

verses.text: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,

xrefs.text: See, my father, look at the corner of your robe in my hand. For I cut it off, but I did not kill you. Know and see that there is no evil or rebellion in my hands. I have not sinned against you, even though you are hunting me down to take my life.
See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
And he continued, “Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done? What evil is in my hand?
And as he yelled curses, Shimei said, “Get out, get out, you worthless man of bloodshed!
“The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! The LORD, the Mighty One, is God! He knows, and may Israel also know. If this was in rebellion or breach of faith against the LORD, do not spare us today.

verses.text: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,

xrefs.text: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
and said to David, “You are more righteous than I, for you have rewarded me with good, though I have rewarded you with evil.
Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember how I stood before You to speak good on their behalf, to turn Your wrath from them.
They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
But David said to Abishai, “Do not destroy him, for who can extend a hand against the LORD’s anointed and be guiltless?”

verses.text: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah

xrefs.text: Then you will trample the wicked, for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day I am preparing,” says the LORD of Hosts.
Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who abandon You will be put to shame. All who turn away will be written in the dust, for they have abandoned the LORD, the fountain of living water.

verses.text: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.

xrefs.text: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
Wake up, O Lord! Why are You sleeping? Arise! Do not reject us forever.
“Now I will arise,” says the LORD. “Now I will lift Myself up. Now I will be exalted.
Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD. Wake up as in days past, as in generations of old. Was it not You who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced through the dragon?

verses.text: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.

xrefs.text: And I heard the angel of the waters say: “Righteous are You, O Holy One, who is and was, because You have brought these judgments.
For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.
Rejoice over her, O heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, because God has pronounced for you His judgment against her.
The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.

verses.text: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.

xrefs.text: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
Why, then, do you judge your brother? Or why do you belittle your brother? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.

For this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God— not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.
Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.

verses.text: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.

xrefs.text: O LORD of Hosts, who judges righteously, who examines the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.
I, the LORD, search the heart; I examine the mind to reward a man according to his way, by what his deeds deserve.
O LORD of Hosts, who examines the righteous, who sees the heart and mind, let me see Your vengeance upon them, for to You I have committed my cause.

As for you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father and serve Him wholeheartedly and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands the intent of every thought. If you seek Him, He will be found by you; but if you forsake Him, He will reject you forever.
But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”

verses.text: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

xrefs.text: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD gives grace and glory; He withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
He who walks with integrity will be kept safe, but whoever is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.
Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
After these events, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: “Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward.”
if you are pure and upright, even now He will rouse Himself on your behalf and restore your righteous estate.

verses.text: God is a righteous judge and a God who feels indignation each day.

xrefs.text: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD is avenging and full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on His foes and reserves wrath for His enemies.
Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.

verses.text: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.

xrefs.text: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
Seek the LORD while He may be found; call on Him while He is near.
when I sharpen My flashing sword, and My hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on My adversaries and repay those who hate Me.
Restore us, O God of our salvation, and put away Your displeasure toward us.

verses.text: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.

xrefs.text: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
You went forth for the salvation of Your people, to save Your anointed. You crushed the head of the house of the wicked and stripped him from head to toe. Selah
He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.

verses.text: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.

xrefs.text: Then after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
You conceive chaff; you give birth to stubble. Your breath is a fire that will consume you.
A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case honestly. They rely on empty pleas; they tell lies; they conceive mischief and give birth to iniquity.

verses.text: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.

xrefs.text: As I have observed, those who plow iniquity and those who sow trouble reap the same.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
He who digs a pit will fall into it, and he who rolls a stone will have it roll back on him.
For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
He who digs a pit may fall into it, and he who breaches a wall may be bitten by a snake.

verses.text: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.

xrefs.text: But when it came before the king, he commanded by letter that the wicked scheme which Haman had devised against the Jews should come back upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,

The LORD will bring his bloodshed back upon his own head, for without the knowledge of my father David he struck down two men more righteous and better than he when he put to the sword Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army.
When the battle intensified against Saul, the archers overtook him and wounded him critically.
May the LORD judge between you and me, and may the LORD take vengeance on you, but my hand will never be against you.

verses.text: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

xrefs.text: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
